name: Soft Overdrive
script:
param a = Drive [0.1, 4.0]
stage1: y = tanh(x * a)

name: Hard Clipper
script:
param a = Threshold [0.1, 1.0]
param b = Drive [0.5, 6.0]
stage1: y = hardclip(x * b, a)

name: Tube Warmth
script:
param a = Drive [0.2, 5.0]
param b = Bias [0.0, 0.3]
param c = Offset [0.0, 0.2]
stage1: y = tanh(x * a + b) - c

name: Fuzz Face
script:
param a = Fuzz [1.0, 12.0]
param b = Tone [400.0, 8000.0]
param c = Bias [-0.4, 0.4]
stage1: y = hardclip((x + c) * a, 0.6)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7

name: Bitcrusher
script:
param a = Bits [2.0, 16.0]
param b = Rate [200.0, 8000.0]
param d = Drive [0.5, 3.0]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = b; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = bitcrush(x * d + y_prev * 0.08 * step(0.0, osc1), a)

name: Fold Distortion
script:
param a = Drive [1.0, 10.0]
param b = FoldMin [-1.0, -0.1]
param c = FoldMax [0.1, 1.0]
param d = Post [0.2, 2.0]
stage1: y = fold(x * a, b, c) * d

name: Classic Tremolo
script:
param a = Rate [0.2, 12.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
param d = Floor [0.0, 1.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (d + (1.0 - d) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))

name: Vibrato
description: Pitch-ähnlicher Vibrato-Effekt durch y_prev Feedback und LFO.
script:
param a = Rate [0.2, 8.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 0.95]
param c = Feedback [0.0, 0.8]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x + y_prev * c + osc1 * b * 0.1

name: Auto-Wah
script:
param a = Sensitivity [0.1, 4.0]
param b = MinCut [200.0, 1200.0]
param c = Sweep [500.0, 6000.0]
param d = Res [0.3, 2.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.005; release = 0.12
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; + = env1; * = c; width = 900
stage1: y = x * 1.1

name: Ring Modulator
description: Multiplikative Ringmodulation mit frei einstellbarer Carrier-Frequenz.
script:
param a = Freq [5.0, 2000.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
param c = Offset [0.0, 1.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b + b * (osc1 + c))

name: Chorus-like
description: Leichte Modulationsbewegung über LFO und Softshaping.
script:
param a = Rate [0.1, 5.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
param c = Detune [0.0, 0.5]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = tanh((x + y_prev * 0.15) * (1.0 + (osc1 + c) * b * 0.35))

name: Phaser-like
script:
param a = Rate [0.1, 6.0]
param b = Depth [200.0, 4000.0]
param c = Base [80.0, 1200.0]
param d = Feedback [0.0, 0.8]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x + y_prev * d
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; + = 0.5; * = b; resonance = 0.9

name: Low Pass Sweep
script:
param a = Rate [0.05, 8.0]
param b = MinCut [120.0, 1200.0]
param c = Depth [400.0, 10000.0]
param d = Res [0.3, 2.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; + = 0.5; * = c; resonance = d

name: High Pass Gate
description: Envelope steuert den Hochpass für gated Bewegung.
script:
param a = Floor [60.0, 1200.0]
param b = Range [300.0, 9000.0]
param c = Attack [1.0, 50.0]
param d = Release [20.0, 400.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = c; release = d
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; + = env1; * = b; resonance = 0.7

name: Vowel Filter
script:
param a = Vowel [0.0, 1.0]
param b = Spread [200.0, 2000.0]
param c = Res [0.5, 3.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 500; + = a; * = 1700; width = b
stage1: y = x
filter2: type = bandpass; center = 1100; + = a; * = 0.7; width = b

name: Telephone EQ
script:
param a = LowCut [120.0, 500.0]
param b = HighCut [2500.0, 5000.0]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.0]
param d = Res [0.3, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = d
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = d
stage1: y = tanh(x * c)

name: Compressor+
script:
param a = Threshold [-36.0, -3.0]
param b = Ratio [1.5, 12.0]
param c = Attack [1.0, 30.0]
param d = Makeup [0.5, 3.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = c; release = 0.12
stage1: y = x * d

name: Transient Shaper
script:
param a = AttackBoost [0.0, 4.0]
param b = Sustain [-1.0, 1.0]
param c = EnvAtk [0.5, 20.0]
param d = EnvRel [20.0, 400.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = c; release = d
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a + b * (1.0 - env1))

name: Gate + Compress
description: Noise Gate vor Kompression für saubere Dynamik.
script:
param a = Gate [0.01, 0.5]
param b = Threshold [-30.0, -6.0]
param c = Ratio [1.5, 10.0]
param d = Release [30.0, 300.0]
stage1: y = x * step(a, abs(x))
comp1: threshold = b; ratio = c; attack = 0.005; release = d

name: Octave Fuzz
script:
param a = Drive [0.5, 8.0]
param b = Tone [300.0, 9000.0]
param d = Level [0.2, 1.5]
stage1: y = tanh(abs(x) * a) * d
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.8

name: Noise Generator
script:
param a = Noise [0.0, 1.0]
param d = Blend [0.0, 1.0]
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - d) + noise(t * sr) * a * d

name: Feedback Delay (einfach)
script:
param a = Feedback [0.0, 0.98]
param b = Input [0.0, 1.5]
param c = Damp [0.0, 1.0]
param d = Mix [0.0, 1.0]
stage1: y = (x * b) * (1.0 - d) + (x + y_prev * a * (1.0 - c)) * d

name: Harmonic Exciter
script:
param a = Drive [0.5, 6.0]
param b = HighFreq [1500.0, 14000.0]
param c = Amount [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.8
stage1: y = x + tanh(x * a) * c
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 18000; resonance = 0.7

name: Lo-Fi Crush
description: Bitcrush + Noise + Tiefpass für Lo-Fi Charakter.
script:
param a = Bits [3.0, 12.0]
param b = Noise [0.0, 0.4]
param c = LP [600.0, 8000.0]
param d = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
stage1: y = bitcrush(tanh(x * d), a) + noise(t * sr * 0.5) * b
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.8

name: Bypass Clean
script: stage1: y = x

name: Gain Staging
script:
param a = Gain [0.1, 4.0]
param b = Trim [0.1, 2.0]
param c = Soft [0.0, 1.0]
stage1: y = (x * a * b) * (1.0 - c) + tanh(x * a * b) * c

name: Parallel Punch
description: Parallel saturation for added density with controlled transients.
script:
param a = Drive [0.5, 6.0]
param b = Blend [0.0, 1.0]
param c = CompThr [-30.0, -6.0]
param d = CompRatio [1.5, 8.0]
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = d; attack = 0.004; release = 0.12
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b) + tanh(x * a) * b

name: Wide Motion
description: Slow, wide LFO sweep with gentle feedback.
script:
param a = Rate [0.05, 3.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
param c = Feedback [0.0, 0.7]
param d = Lowpass [700.0, 12000.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = tanh((x + y_prev * c) * (1.0 + osc1 * b * 0.4))
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.8

name: Tight Gate
description: Fast noise gate with optional soft-release character.
script:
param a = Threshold [0.01, 0.6]
param b = ReleaseMix [0.0, 1.0]
param c = Drive [0.5, 2.5]
param d = Output [0.5, 1.8]
stage1: y = (x * step(a, abs(x))) * (1.0 - b) + (x + y_prev * 0.2) * b
stage2: y = tanh(y * c) * d

name: Blues Driver
description: Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.
script:
param a = Drive [0.2, 5.0]
param b = Tone [400.0, 8000.0]
stage1: y = tanh(x * a + 0.05)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7

name: Metal Scoop
script:
param a = Gain [2.0, 14.0]
param b = Presence [2000.0, 12000.0]
param c = Gate [0.01, 0.35]
stage1: y = hardclip(x * a, 0.55) * step(c, abs(x))
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.6
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5

name: Clean Sparkle
description: Transparent boost with airy top end.
script:
param a = Boost [0.8, 2.5]
param b = Air [3000.0, 14000.0]
param c = Warmth [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = x * a * (1.0 - c) + tanh(x * a) * c

name: Acoustic Body
description: Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.
script:
param a = Body [120.0, 600.0]
param b = Res [0.4, 2.2]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = b
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.08

name: Riff Sustain
script:
param a = Sustain [1.0, 8.0]
param b = Comp [1.5, 8.0]
comp1: threshold = -20; ratio = b; attack = 0.008; release = 0.18
stage1: y = tanh(x * a)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3200; resonance = 0.8

name: Chug Palm Mute
script:
param a = Punch [1.0, 10.0]
param b = Low [80.0, 400.0]
param c = Gate [0.02, 0.4]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 260; resonance = 1.4
stage1: y = hardclip(x * a, 0.5) * step(c, abs(x))

name: Sub Weight
description: Adds controlled sub and tight low end.
script:
param a = Sub [40.0, 180.0]
param b = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
comp1: threshold = -22; ratio = 4; attack = 0.012; release = 0.2
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.9
stage1: y = tanh(x * b)

name: Pick Attack
script:
param a = Attack [0.5, 6.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 2; release = 0.09
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a + 0.1)

name: Bass Growl
script:
param a = Growl [1.0, 12.0]
param b = Mid [300.0, 1800.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 400; resonance = 1.2
stage1: y = tanh((x + 0.05) * a)

name: DI Warmth
description: Smooth DI saturation for studio bass.
script:
param a = Warmth [0.0, 1.0]
param b = Drive [0.3, 3.0]
param c = HighCut [2000.0, 12000.0]
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - a) + tanh(x * b) * a
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.6

name: Vocal Presence
script:
param a = Presence [1500.0, 8000.0]
param b = Amount [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 900; resonance = 1.0
stage1: y = x + tanh(x) * b * 0.25

name: Vocal Warmth
description: Gentle low-mid warmth for thin voices.
script:
param a = Warmth [200.0, 900.0]
param b = Soft [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = 0.8
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b) + tanh(x) * b

name: Vocal De-Ess
script:
param a = Freq [4000.0, 12000.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 1; release = 0.04
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.7
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - env1 * b * 0.35)

name: Vocal Double
script:
param a = Detune [0.0, 0.4]
param b = DelayFb [0.0, 0.6]
param c = Blend [0.0, 1.0]
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - c) + (x + y_prev * b + a * 0.05) * c

name: Podcast Voice
script:
param a = Comp [2.0, 10.0]
param b = LowCut [60.0, 250.0]
comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = a; attack = 0.006; release = 0.14
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6
stage1: y = tanh(x * 1.1)

name: Kick Punch
description: Adds click and sub punch to kicks.
script:
param a = Click [2000.0, 12000.0]
param b = Sub [40.0, 120.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 2200; resonance = 1.1
stage1: y = tanh(x * 2.0)

name: Snare Crack
script:
param a = Snap [1500.0, 9000.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.9
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.15

name: Drum Bus Glue
script:
param a = Threshold [-24.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [1.5, 6.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.003; release = 0.09
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + 0.1)

name: Hi-Hat Tamer
script:
param a = Cut [6000.0, 16000.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = x * step(0.04, abs(x))

name: Room Explosion
script:
param a = Room [0.0, 0.85]
param b = Tone [500.0, 6000.0]
stage1: y = x + y_prev * a
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7

name: Supersaw Grit
script:
param a = Detune [0.0, 0.5]
param b = Drive [0.5, 6.0]
stage1: y = tanh((x + y_prev * a * 0.2) * b)

name: Acid Line
script:
param a = Res [0.8, 3.5]
param b = Cutoff [200.0, 4000.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 2; release = 0.06
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; + = env1; * = 2200; resonance = a
stage1: y = tanh(x * 2.5)

name: Pad Swell
script:
param a = Rate [0.05, 2.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (0.3 + 0.7 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * b)

name: Pluck Bite
script:
param a = Bite [0.5, 5.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 1; release = 0.055
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.7
stage1: y = x * (1.0 + env1 * a * 0.2)

name: Arp Shimmer
script:
param a = Sparkle [4000.0, 16000.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 2.5; depth = 1.0
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.6
stage1: y = x + osc1 * 0.03

name: Mix Glue
description: Light bus glue for mix cohesion.
script:
param a = Threshold [-20.0, -4.0]
param b = Ratio [1.2, 4.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.01; release = 0.2
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - 0.2) + tanh(x) * 0.2

name: Loudness Safe
description: Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.
script:
param a = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
param b = Ceiling [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = hardclip(tanh(x * a), b)

name: Stereo Shine
script:
param a = Air [5000.0, 16000.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - 0.35) + tanh(x) * 0.35

name: Low End Control
description: Tames boomy low end on mixes.
script:
param a = Freq [30.0, 150.0]
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = 3.5; attack = 0.02; release = 0.22
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.7
stage1: y = x

name: Stutter Gate
script:
param a = Rate [2.0, 32.0]
osc1: shape = square; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (0.15 + 0.85 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))

name: Granular Cloud
script:
param a = Texture [0.0, 0.95]
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - 0.75) + (x + y_prev * a + noise(t * sr) * 0.08) * 0.75

name: Reverse Swell FX
script:
param a = Swell [0.1, 2.0]
param b = Feedback [0.0, 0.9]
stage1: y = (x + y_prev * b) * a
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 1800; resonance = 0.8

name: Bitcrush Glitch
script:
param a = Bits [2.0, 12.0]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = 3000; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = bitcrush(x + osc1 * 0.05, a)

name: Radio Interference
script:
param a = Tune [200.0, 3000.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = (x * (1.0 - 0.5) + osc1 * 0.08) + noise(t * sr) * 0.12

name: Tape Wobble
script:
param a = Wow [0.1, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.12 + osc1 * 0.04

name: Vinyl Crackle
description: Dusty vinyl layer with bandwidth limit.
script:
param a = Crackle [0.0, 0.4]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 2600; resonance = 0.6
stage1: y = x * 0.85 + noise(t * sr) * a

name: Cassette Warm
script:
param a = Warmth [0.0, 1.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3400; resonance = 0.7
stage1: y = tanh(x * (1.0 + a)) + noise(t * sr) * 0.04

name: 8-Bit Game
script:
param a = Bits [3.0, 8.0]
stage1: y = bitcrush(tanh(x * 1.8), a)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4200; resonance = 0.5

name: Sidechain Pump
script:
param a = Rate [0.5, 8.0]
param b = Depth [0.0, 1.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))

name: Dubstep Growl
script:
param a = Growl [1.0, 12.0]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = 8; depth = 1.0
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400; + = osc1; * = 1800; resonance = 1.8
stage1: y = tanh(x * a)

name: Trance Gate
script:
param a = Steps [4.0, 32.0]
osc1: shape = square; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (0.1 + 0.9 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))

name: Riser Builder
script:
param a = Rise [0.1, 4.0]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * 0.3 + noise(t * sr) * 0.55 + osc1 * 0.05

name: Drone Layer
script:
param a = Sustain [0.0, 0.98]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.2; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * 0.2 + (x + y_prev * a) * 0.8

name: Ethereal Wash
script:
param a = Shimmer [0.0, 1.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.35; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = tanh((x + osc1 * 0.04) * (1.0 + a * 0.3))

name: Dark Atmosphere
script:
param a = Dark [40.0, 300.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 500; resonance = 1.1
stage1: y = x * 0.3 + noise(t * sr) * 0.22 + y_prev * 0.15

name: Crystal Pad
script:
param a = Crystal [3000.0, 14000.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - 0.35) + tanh(x * 1.5) * 0.35
